title: Multiproxy evidence highlights a complex evolutionary legacy of maize in South America
version: Science 362(6420), pp. 1309–1313, DOI 10.1126/science.aav0207. White Rose institutional repository accepted manuscript.
lineage: Independent paleogenetic and modern landrace samples for regional crop ancestry, combined with a synthesis that cites the existing early archaeological dates. It does not date Par_N1 or identify an individual source settlement.

passages.note: Genomes support movement of an ancestral maize population from Mexico to South America, with domestication traits potentially still evolving after the move.
